paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three different tools, TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT, in analyzing two categories of tweets: Emoji Tweets and Overall Tweets. The horizontal axis contains the categories 'Emoji Tweets' and 'Overall Tweets', with a sub-category under each labeled as 'Overall Tweets and Tweets containing emojis'. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as 'Accuracy', with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, marked at intervals of 0.1 but labeled only at the interval of 0.2. Each category contains three bars representing the tools: TEXTBLOB is shown with a white fill and a black outline, VADER with diagonal stripes, and ChatGPT in green. For 'Emoji Tweets,' TEXTBLOB shows an accuracy of approximately 0.3, VADER near 0.45, and ChatGPT around 0.65. In the 'Overall Tweet' category, TEXTBLOB has an accuracy of 0.4 and VADER has an accuracy near 0.45, while ChatGPT reaches approximately 0.65. The bars are organized by tool within each category, and there is no specific emphasis or sorting applied to the bars. A legend is on the bottom right of the plot, overlapping the bars of the "Overall Tweet" category.
